ItemId.description: The policy id; omit to match by scope and name.

Name.description: The policy name, unique within its scope.

Scope.description: The kind of work the policy is for: the name of a registered scope. It names the metrics and priorities.

HoursScheduleId.description: The business hours schedule the targets are counted in. Empty counts around the clock.

WarningPercent.description: How much of a target, in percent, passes before a warning is raised. 80 when omitted.

Priority.description: The priority key the target is for, as the scope keys its priorities. Empty for every priority without a target of its own.

Minutes.description: The time allowed, in minutes of the policy's hours.

Targets.description: The time allowed for each metric at each priority.

Properties.description: Settings other modules keep on the policy, such as the work order statuses that pause its timers.

Policies.description: The policies to create, or update by id or by scope and name.
